business_problem: As SharkNinja expanded globally, its customized legacy technology environment created fragmented processes, disconnected data, spreadsheet-heavy reporting, and multiple versions of the truth. It needed a scalable, adaptable platform to simplify and connect operations.
solution_summary: SharkNinja uses Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications as a unified system of record connecting finance and supply chain; the release does not specify source-system ingestion, data-store internals, or deployment topology. Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) automates routine finance tasks, increases visibility, and strengthens controls. Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) streamlines financial planning and reporting and provides more timely insights for decision-making. Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SCM) helps identify and resolve order exceptions and coordinate order management with supply-chain processes. Oracle Integration (OIC) simplifies integrations across global operations; its AI identifies and flags integration errors, including EDI transaction issues, helping teams diagnose and resolve them faster and keep orders and data flowing. Across these applications, embedded AI completes tasks, generates content, and provides insights and recommendations.
